text:
Maria G: heads up — deploybot paused promo for canary-2026.03.22 because a staging job failed on artifact extraction.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: canary-2026.03.22 -> hold reason: staging/job-6543 wheel-extract-error (automated).
CI Bot: failed job log snippet: 
```
ERROR: wheel unpack failed
tar: Unexpected EOF in archive
OSError: [Errno 24] Too many open files
mmap(): failed to map file descriptor
```
Sam L: ugh EMFILE from worker — we've seen this once before with mmap + large cache shards.
Olivia N: @Maria any idea if this is infra (runner) or artifact itself?
Maria G: initial triage: artifact uploaded OK to mirror, but during extract the worker process hit fd limit. logs show a burst of concurrent unpack processes.
Kevin O: sounds like shared-cache TTL/GC churn caused many runners to re-fetch and unpack simultaneously. we had a TTL spike last night due to a bad config push.
Sam L: can we rerun just the failing job on a fresh runner with higher ulimit? quick test first.
Olivia N: I can spin a runner with ulimit -n 65536 and run the job. If it passes, we can unhold and promote.
Maria G: two options: 1) manual pin to last-successful image and promote now (fast, avoids re-run) OR 2) rerun single job on tuned runner and then unhold if green. preference?
Kevin O: pinning hides the underlying issue — prefer rerun. also add a short-term throttle on cache rehydration so we don't thundering-herd.
Sam L: agreed — rerun + throttle. I'll create a rerun job with env RUNNER_ULIMIT=65536 and CACHE_PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=2.
Sam L: command I will run: `ci rerun job staging/job-6543 --runner-config=runc-quiet --env RUNNER_ULIMIT=65536`
deploy-bot: Manual hold still in place. To unhold run `deploy-bot promote --force PROMO_ID` once CI green.
CI Bot: rerun queued on runc-quiet-42. expected start in ~2m.
Olivia N: watching logs. side check: artifact checksum matches mirror (sha256 OK). not corrupted.
CI Bot: staging/job-6543 (rerun) started on runc-quiet-42.
CI Bot: staging/job-6543 (rerun) completed — success.
Sam L: rerun succeeded on high-ulimit runner. no tar EOF, no EMFILE.
Kevin O: implemented CACHE_PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=2 on the runner pool as emergency throttle. will follow up with a config rollback PR to fix the TTL churn root cause.
Maria G: consensus to unhold and promote?
Olivia N: +1 from oncall, logs look clean.
Sam L: +1, I validated artifact checksums and smoke tests.
Maria G: OK, I'm running the promote now.
deploy-bot: Promotion resumed: canary-2026.03.22 -> promoted to stable. triggered by Maria G.
Maria G: note for release notes: issue was transient FD exhaustion due to a cache TTL/config change causing many concurrent unpack ops. mitigation: temporary throttle + runner ulimit bump; follow-up: revert bad TTL change and add a CI guard.
Kevin O: filed infra ticket INFRA-1289 with details and proposed rollback of TTL change.
Maria G: thanks team — closing thread. :thumbsup:
